note: Edit the numbers to change the dashboard's frequency levels. A reading takes the first level whose range contains it; anything outside the Alert range is Critical.

bands.source: Dashboard setting: normal regulation range (±0.2 Hz). Not set by a standard; adjust as needed.
Within the continuous-operation limits for conventional generators used in North American practice (59.4–60.6 Hz; WECC off-nominal frequency plan, AESO ISO Rule 503.6).
Inside IEEE 1547-2018 continuous operation (58.8–61.2 Hz) but beyond the generator continuous limits above, where operation is time-limited (3 minutes in WECC/AESO practice).
Outside IEEE 1547-2018 continuous operation: mandatory ride-through for up to 299 s, then IEEE 1547 trip settings apply.
